scope: 三条实际 Codex native 会话完成活动内容和现场保障的筹备分工、两轮自然追问、接续、独立复核、整改返检与最终筹备交付；场地、设备、人员、材料和活动执行的现场事实仍待确认。

remote_receipt.scope: Actual Git transport and GitHub API independently matched after successful terminal push handle67897; artifact commit contains only 859 SC004 files.

checks.name: natural_client_initiation
checks.result: Canonical initial business request occurred once in the actual coordinator native thread; the 13-input retrospective audit distinguishes natural business inputs from three host setup envelopes.

checks.name: tool_or_role_execution
checks.result: Three distinct Codex native threads performed coordinator/content, peer/venue and successor/venue work. Public evidence binds actual authorship, AWR sessions/claims/branches, RevisionConflict and later ClaimConflict without equating runtime branches to isolated Git worktrees.

checks.name: real_artifact
checks.result: The final sealed snapshot contains eight hash-bound business/review/delivery artifacts with authorship attributed to actual producing turns rather than shared snapshot membership.

checks.name: business_followup_1
checks.result: The first canonical followup introduced the temporary absence, was sent once to the actual coordinator, and led to a separately executed successor handoff that preserved unresolved venue matters.

checks.name: business_followup_2
checks.result: The second canonical followup requested separate result checks and common actions; the coordinator then corrected the stale handoff wording and formed the combined preparation plan.

checks.name: independent_review
checks.result: A distinct luna_worker reviewer raised XQ-R01/R02, the original producer remediated them, and the same reviewer independently rechecked and closed both findings with ended sessions and released claims.

checks.name: final_delivery
checks.result: After recheck, the original coordinator produced the final preparation delivery. Root and a distinct read-only reviewer verified the sealed final turn and its scope; onsite readiness, execution and release remain outside this gate.

checks.name: traceable_receipt
checks.result: Twelve standard phase seals/extracts, the custom peer publication, 258 final receipt files, 359 fixed review inputs, retained prior/review files and all known failures remain hash-bound. Raw events and native transcripts are excluded from public copying.

checks.name: fixture_isolation
checks.result: The run retains its independent fixture namespace and seed project. The final source/artifact snapshots are tied to this project, while the untouched run.json remains a historical preparation receipt and is not treated as proof of later execution.

checks.name: independent_commit_and_remote_sha
checks.result: Case-only artifact commit df85063e99454b66eae218ecb1c4a75ba10d763f was independently verified through Git transport and GitHub API after successful push.

limitations: This isolated synthetic business loop proves the preparation collaboration and delivery; it does not establish onsite readiness, event execution, customer UAT or a released product.
Actual identities are three native thread IDs and the distinct luna_worker reviewer. AWR caller agent/provider/model labels do not prove native identity.
The AWR runtime branch was bound to refs/heads/main in a shared directory; it did not create filesystem or Git worktree isolation.
Original scope wording, two review findings, failed commands, correction attempts and separate operator preparation failures remain retained and do not count as successful actions.
The historical gate-review and execution record describe the pre-remote stage. This later acceptance binds the immutable artifact commit without changing those bytes.
Private native context, memory/reasoning, raw events and runtime databases remain locally retained; published business extracts provide source, command and output hashes.
